items.title: Iran war could last another year, oil prices rising
items.feedTitle: Iran War Updates: Trump envoy says war could last another year as oil prices continue rising
items.summary: A Trump envoy warned that the ongoing conflict with Iran could extend for another year as oil prices continue climbing. Brent crude has reached its highest level since May, with futures trading around $116 per barrel, driven by escalating tensions in the Middle East. The prolonged conflict threatens to keep energy costs elevated heading into the midterm elections, which could impact voter sentiment on the economy.

items.title: Melania Trump secures localized Russia-Ukraine ceasefire
items.feedTitle: Melania Trump brokers localized Russia-Ukraine ceasefire, White House says
items.summary: The White House announced that First Lady Melania Trump has brokered a localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the front-line city of Oleshky, set to begin Thursday. The agreement will allow both nations to temporarily halt military action to permit humanitarian aid and civilian evacuation in the war-ravaged area. However, neither Russia nor Ukraine has yet confirmed the ceasefire independently.

items.title: Trump administration files lawsuit over Alaska Senate results
items.feedTitle: Trump administration files lawsuit to block possible Democratic win in Alaska Senate race
items.summary: The Trump administration has filed a lawsuit challenging possible Democratic gains in Alaska's U.S. Senate race, claiming voter confusion over two candidates named Dan Sullivan could favor Democrat Mary Peltola. The legal challenge has sparked concerns about a prolonged federal battle with states over election certification and voting procedures.

items.title: 72-year-old arrested in dramatic display over voter fraud claims
items.feedTitle: ‘They wanted to make a scene’: the 72-year-old paraded in dramatic arrest for ‘voter fraud’
items.summary: A 72-year-old immigrant seeking U.S. citizenship was arrested in a high-profile manner as part of the Trump administration's crackdown on alleged illegal voting. The dramatic arrest has drawn criticism from voting rights advocates who say the administration is targeting naturalization applicants in an apparent effort to intimidate voters ahead of the midterm elections.

items.title: DHS voter roll checks raise federal election interference concerns
items.feedTitle: DOJ monitoring plans and DHS voter checks raise concerns of election interference
items.summary: With less than two weeks until midterms, a federal judge has blocked a Department of Homeland Security effort to identify noncitizens on voter rolls, raising new legal questions about federal involvement in policing voter eligibility. The ruling has sparked concerns among voting rights advocates that the government is overstepping its authority in election administration.

stlouis.title: BJC breaks from major insurance plans affecting thousands of seniors
stlouis.feedTitle: BJC breaks from some Anthem, Aetna insurance plans. Will affect thousands of seniors.
stlouis.summary: BJC HealthCare has ended partnerships with some Anthem and Aetna insurance plans, a move that will impact thousands of seniors in the St. Louis area who depend on these coverage options. The insurance changes will force affected beneficiaries to find alternative coverage or switch healthcare providers.

stlouis.title: Man admits setting fires at metro-east massage parlors
stlouis.feedTitle: Man burned down Metro East massage parlor, killing woman inside, over sexual encounter, investigators say
stlouis.summary: A St. Louis man has admitted to setting fires at metro-east area massage parlors, including one that killed a woman inside, according to ATF investigators. The arsons were allegedly motivated by a personal dispute following a sexual encounter, marking a serious crime spree across the Illinois-Missouri border region.

stlouis.title: Missouri ramps up preparations for Medicaid work requirements
stlouis.feedTitle: Missouri ramps up preparations for new Medicaid work requirements
stlouis.summary: Missouri is preparing to implement new work requirements for Medicaid recipients, reflecting a broader policy shift across states. The state is conducting outreach and planning for the program changes that will affect thousands of low-income residents receiving federal health insurance assistance.

items.title: Two Israeli soldiers killed in West Bank attack by Palestinians
items.feedTitle: Two Israeli soldiers killed in attack by suspected Palestinian gunmen in West Bank
items.summary: Two Israeli soldiers were killed in a shooting attack in the occupied West Bank on Friday, with two suspected Palestinian gunmen also dying in the exchange of fire outside Hebron. The violence is likely to heighten political tensions ahead of Israel's parliamentary election scheduled for next week.

items.title: Magnitude-7 earthquake strikes Tibet, killing at least 16
items.feedTitle: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes
items.summary: A powerful magnitude-7 earthquake hit northern Tibet, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54, and destroying hundreds of homes in the remote region of Nagqu. Search and rescue efforts are ongoing in the mountainous, sparsely-populated area after at least seven aftershocks were recorded following the initial quake.

items.title: France deploys 70,000 police to control Saturday protests
items.feedTitle: French authorities deploy 70,000 officers for Saturday protests; Louvre and other museums closed
items.summary: French authorities are mobilizing 70,000 police officers across the country for Saturday to manage widespread protests and prevent further unrest. The deployment follows violent street demonstrations that have gripped the nation, with the Louvre and other major museums closing out of precaution.

items.title: Mystery over source of Nigeria's Ebola case raises spread fears
items.feedTitle: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus
items.summary: Health officials across Africa are racing to determine how Nigeria's first Ebola patient in over a decade became infected, amid fears the outbreak could spread further. The patient is believed to be the wife of a Swiss diplomat and likely contracted the virus while traveling in Uganda, prompting urgent epidemiological investigation.

items.title: US-Iran war landscape transformed since conflict began
items.feedTitle: US-Iran war, then and now: How the landscape has changed since February
items.summary: Analysts report that the positions of both Washington and Tehran have shifted dramatically since US-Israeli strikes began the war earlier this year. The military and diplomatic dynamics have evolved substantially, affecting regional security calculations and the potential for further escalation.

items.title: India-China agree to discuss LAC border understanding improvements
items.feedTitle: India Exposes Xi's Arunachal Duplicity; Fresh Face-Offs On LAC As China Breaks Patrolling Rules
items.summary: India and China have agreed to discuss ways to improve understanding and management of their disputed border, the Line of Actual Control, according to India's Ministry of External Affairs. The commitment reflects ongoing efforts to reduce tensions through dialogue despite recent military face-offs reported by the ITBP chief.

items.title: India achieves historic medal haul at Asian Para Games
items.feedTitle: Asian Para Games: India surpass 2022 tally, set new record with 114 medals, 30 gold
items.summary: India concluded the Asian Para Games with its best-ever medal tally of 114 medals, including 30 gold, surpassing the 2022 performance and becoming only the sixth nation to cross the 100-medal barrier. The historic achievement underscores India's growing competitive strength in Paralympic sports across multiple disciplines.

items.title: Marco Rubio's India port visit marks paradigm shift in ties
items.feedTitle: Marco Rubio: Did domestic pressure make US secretary of state visit an Indian port town?
items.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's visit to a small Indian port town signals a shift in America's diplomatic and energy agenda toward India, departing from traditional high-level summits. The visit reflects the Trump administration's focus on practical business and energy partnerships over conventional diplomatic protocol.

items.title: Cyclone alert issued for Odisha-Andhra Pradesh coasts
items.feedTitle: Weather system over Bay of Bengal may intensify into cyclone, cross Odisha-Andhra coasts by October 28
items.summary: The India Meteorological Department has issued red alert for heavy rain in five Odisha districts as a weather system over the Bay of Bengal intensifies toward cyclone status. The system is expected to cross the Odisha-Andhra Pradesh coasts by October 28, with residents advised to prepare for severe weather conditions.

items.title: At least four dead in blast in Bihar’s Siwan district
items.feedTitle: At least four dead in blast in Bihar’s Siwan district
items.summary: Summary unavailable for this update.

immigration.title: Trump administration ends H-1B extension protections and limits renewals
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Administration Moves to End H-1B Extension Protections, Finalizes Restrictions on Work Permit Renewals
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has moved to end automatic protections for H-1B visa extensions and has finalized restrictions on work permit renewals, creating new uncertainty for Indian and other international workers. The policy, finalized and now in effect, removes provisions that previously allowed workers to remain in the U.S. while extensions were pending.

immigration.title: Indian EB-2 green card backlog frozen at 2013 visa priority date
immigration.feedTitle: Indian EB-2 Green Card Backlog Remains Stuck in 2013 as White House Reviews Premium Processing Changes
immigration.summary: The EB-2 employment-based green card category for Indian applicants remains stuck at the 2013 priority date with no advancement in the November 2026 visa bulletin, a stalled status that affects hundreds of thousands of workers. While the White House reviews premium processing changes, Indian professionals face indefinite delays with no clear resolution in sight.

immigration.title: Trump visa revocations surge past 300,000 under new crackdown
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Visa Revocations Surge Past 300,000 as Crackdown Accelerates
immigration.summary: Visa revocations under the Trump administration have topped 300,000, representing a broad immigration vetting crackdown that has expanded beyond previous programs. The State Department announced this escalation in its enforcement efforts targeting visa holders across multiple categories and nationalities.

items.title: Oil hits $115 barrel as Iran tensions intensify Middle East risk
items.feedTitle: Oil price rises above $115 a barrel amid fears US will renew strikes on Iran
items.summary: Brent crude has surged above $115 per barrel—its highest level in more than five months—as fears of renewed U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran grip energy markets. Tehran's threats of retaliatory attacks on Gulf refineries and critical infrastructure are driving the rally alongside ongoing Saudi-Houthi confrontations.

items.title: Indian markets fall for fourth consecutive session on geopolitical tensions
items.feedTitle: Sensex, Nifty Fall for Fourth Consecutive Session as Geopolitical Tensions Rattle Indian Markets
items.summary: The Sensex and Nifty indices fell for the fourth consecutive day amid escalating Middle East tensions and crude oil prices nearing $114 per barrel. Geopolitical risks and elevated energy costs have prompted broad-based selling across Indian equities, pressuring both large-cap and small-cap segments.

items.title: Nasdaq tumbles after tech sell-off driven by AI spending concerns
items.feedTitle: Stock Market Today (Oct. 23, 2026): Nasdaq falls following tech sell-off
items.summary: The Nasdaq index declined sharply as technology stocks sold off on concerns about the sustainability and profitability of massive AI infrastructure spending. The sell-off reflects investor worries that mega-cap tech companies may be overinvesting in AI without clear returns, triggering broader market weakness.

items.title: Apple reclaims world's most valuable company from Nvidia
items.feedTitle: King Apple is taking Wall Street’s top spot back from Nvidia — for the fifth time
items.summary: Apple has overtaken Nvidia to become the world's most valuable public company for the fifth time, reflecting rotation among mega-cap tech stocks. The shift highlights market volatility and changing investor sentiment toward different technology sectors, particularly amid AI valuation debates.

items.title: American Express cuts 5% of workforce to prepare for AI
items.feedTitle: American Express is cutting 5% of its workforce to 'prepare for AI'
items.summary: American Express announced it is cutting about 3,500 jobs—approximately 5% of its workforce—as part of a restructuring effort to position the company for AI integration and cost efficiency. The move comes as the company lifted its 2026 profit forecast, suggesting the layoffs are part of a broader strategic pivot rather than distress-driven cuts.

finance.note: Oil prices surged above $115 per barrel on escalating Iran war concerns and Saudi-Houthi tensions, reaching five-month highs and pressuring global equities. U.S. stocks fell for a fourth consecutive session, with the Nasdaq hit hard by AI spending sustainability worries; Indian markets (Nifty, Sensex) also declined for the fourth straight day amid geopolitical risks and crude volatility. Watch: whether Israel-U.S. resume Iran strikes post-elections and if oil prices stabilize or spike further; Fed policy response to inflation and treasury yield movements; and earnings season progress amid AI capex concerns.

cards.title: The Attention Economy Is Rigged Against You
cards.insight: Modern work environments are designed to fragment focus—constant notifications, open floor plans, and always-on communication tools destroy deep work. The problem isn't your willpower; the environment systematically prevents sustained concentration on cognitively demanding tasks.
cards.takeaway: Audit your environment this week: disable notifications for 90-minute blocks, establish a 'focus window' time each day when you're unreachable, and move non-urgent communication to batched check-ins.

cards.title: Knowledge Work Isn't About Hours, It's About State
cards.insight: Productivity metrics that reward 'time spent' miss the reality: a 2-hour deep work session often outproduces 8 hours of scattered effort. Your mental state—not clock time—determines output quality. Switching costs between tasks are massive and invisible.
cards.takeaway: Track your peak focus hours this week and ruthlessly protect them. If you're most creative at 6–8 AM, don't schedule meetings then. Treat focus blocks like unmissable client calls.

cards.title: Saying No Is a Productivity Superpower
cards.insight: Every commitment you make is attention you're removing from something else. The default human tendency is to say yes to new requests, but each yes erodes your ability to excel at existing work. Saying no isn't selfish—it's how you protect your capacity for high-impact work.
cards.takeaway: Before accepting a new project or meeting this week, ask: 'What will I stop doing if I do this?' If the answer is 'something important,' practice saying 'I can't take this on right now' instead of defaulting to yes.

cards.title: Recovery Time Is When the Work Happens
cards.insight: Your brain consolidates learning and insights during downtime, not during active work. Skipping breaks, working through lunch, and staying 'on' all evening sabotage productivity by preventing the mental processing that turns effort into progress. Rest isn't laziness—it's infrastructure.
cards.takeaway: Schedule a 15-minute real break (away from screens) every 90 minutes this week. A walk, lunch with your phone put away, or even staring out a window primes your brain for better problem-solving in the next session.

ai.title: OpenAI cuts fundraising valuation target to $1.25 trillion
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI cuts fundraising valuation target to $1.25 trillion after investor pushback
ai.summary: OpenAI has reduced its valuation target in an ongoing funding round to $1.25 trillion, down $150 billion from earlier expectations, after pushback from major investors. The lower target reflects investor caution about AI company valuations and concerns over the sustainability of AI infrastructure spending.

ai.title: Anthropic debuts Claude Duet personal AI agent app
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic debuts Claude Duet personal AI agent. Here's what to know.
ai.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a personal AI agent application available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users. The app represents Anthropic's bet on the emerging AI agent market as companies race to deploy autonomous AI systems for productivity and task automation.

ai.title: Fired OpenAI researchers break silence on dramatic dismissal
ai.feedTitle: Fired OpenAI researchers give their first interview since their dramatic dismissal : Machine Gods
ai.summary: Three OpenAI researchers who were dismissed have given their first interview since their sudden firing, shedding light on the circumstances surrounding their departure. The researchers discuss their concerns about the company's direction and internal disputes that led to their termination.

ai.title: Microsoft develops AI diagnostic tool that rivals specialist doctors
ai.feedTitle: Microsoft develops AI tool that can diagnose 'sequentially' like a doctor
ai.summary: Microsoft has developed an AI-powered diagnostic system that performs comparably to human specialists on difficult medical cases, according to a study published in Science. The tool represents progress toward 'medical superintelligence,' though much of the improvement derives from underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system alone.

ai.title: Canva releases its first generative image model
ai.feedTitle: Canva releases its first image generation model
ai.summary: Canva has launched its first proprietary image generation model, making it available to all users and promising improved performance and customization at lower costs than competitors. The new model positions Canva as a serious competitor to larger AI image platforms like DALL-E and Midjourney.
